items.title: A $52 Billion Fund Bought These 3 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $52 billion fund’s three biggest additions in the second quarter were Boston Scientific, Tango Therapeutics and GRAIL, according to its 13F as of June 30. Analysts have cut their average Boston Scientific target by more than half over the past year, while they’ve more than tripled Tango’s and nearly doubled GRAIL’s.

items.title: What Heartflow (HTFL) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
items.summary: Heartflow (NASDAQ:HTFL) raised its 2026 revenue forecast after reporting third-quarter sales growth of 57%, citing wider adoption of its Plaque Analysis product, durable demand for FFRct and growth in coronary CT angiography. The company reported revenue of $72.9 million for the quarter ended Sept.
